title: bug: A branch name containing a pipe character (vertical bar, `|`) causes a 500 server error on the commit graph page.
body:
### Can you reproduce the bug on the Forgejo test instance?

Yes, I've linked the repository below

### Description

An HTTP 500 error occurs with the following steps.

1. Create a branch with a name that includes a pipe character (`|`).
2. Access the commit graph page.

Note: Although branch names containing pipe characters are unusual, they [don’t seem to be disallowed](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-check-ref-format).

Links to reproduce:

* [The repository to reproduce this on v16.next.forgejo.org](https://v16.next.forgejo.org/mjy/commit_graph_error_with_pipe_char_branch)
* [The branch that causes the issue (here, using the name `test|branch`)](https://v16.next.forgejo.org/mjy/commit_graph_error_with_pipe_char_branch/src/branch/test%7Cbranch)
* [Its commit graph page (which returns a 500 error here)](https://v16.next.forgejo.org/mjy/commit_graph_error_with_pipe_char_branch/graph)

### Screenshots

![image](/attachments/9b44ee21-bd05-45ad-a3d4-a9c246a13d29)

### Forgejo Version

Forgejo version: 16.0.5-7-6f1c1a40bd+gitea-1.22.0

### Browser Version

Firefox, Chrome, curl

title: problem: TemporaryUploadRepository needs refactoring
body:
### Does your problem still exist on the latest Forgejo version?

Unknown, I can't try it for some reason (please explain)

### About your usage of Forgejo

Development

### Problem description

- Many methods of `TemporaryUploadRepository` were straight up seemingly copied from `Repository` seven years ago. In many cases, `Repository` has moved on, `TemporaryUploadRepository` hasn't, and there's lots of "duplication". Some efforts to invoke the "duplicated methods" via `t.gitRepo` have been made, but are not complete.

e.g.

https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/commit/eb88aa294b79030afb01539a089dd93944acd409/services/repository/files/temp_repo.go#L191-L204

https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/commit/eb88aa294b79030afb01539a089dd93944acd409/modules/git/repo_index.go#L135-L151

- The fact that `TemporaryUploadRepository` doesn't use modern structs e.g. `ObjectID` or...

https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/commit/eb88aa294b79030afb01539a089dd93944acd409/services/repository/files/temp_repo.go#L216-L223

https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/src/commit/eb88aa294b79030afb01539a089dd93944acd409/modules/git/repo_tree.go#L24-L29

... makes it particularly painful to work with on the "lower levels" (e.g. `GetDiffPreview`, which I worked on/with over at https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14559), as everything is basically a string.
